description: An extension to the OnboardingView class providing asynchronous functions for permission management, monitoring, CLI installation, and gateway probing.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Refreshes permission status asynchronously by calling refreshNow on permissionMonitor.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Requests a specific capability asynchronously, ensuring mutual exclusion with an isRequesting flag.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring
methods.description: Sets monitoring state for permissions based on the current page index.

methods.name: updateDiscoveryMonitoring
methods.description: Starts or stops gateway discovery monitoring depending on the page index.

methods.name: updateMonitoring
methods.description: Updates both permission and discovery monitoring and possibly triggers onboarding chat.

methods.name: stopDiscovery
methods.description: Stops gateway discovery if it is active.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Asynchronously installs CLI if not already installing, updating status accordingly.

methods.name: refreshCLIStatus
methods.description: Retrieves CLI installation location and updates related UI state.

methods.name: refreshLocalGatewayProbe
methods.description: Queries port description and updates local gateway probe info based on command analysis.
